singleSourced.context: The first major The Blood of Dawnwalker update will introduce an easier difficulty option for "people who don't want to experience combat" when it launches in October.
It was released for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S September 3 and reached more than 1 million copies sold in just two days.
For more on The Blood of Dawnwalker, you can read about how Bandai Namco and Rebel Wolves managed to bring their vision to life on a $40 million budget.
